topic.angle: A warship that barely left the harbour

body.question: The Swedish warship Vasa set out on her maiden voyage on 10 August 1628. About how far did she sail before she sank?
body.reveal: Vasa sank after sailing roughly 1,300 m (1,400 yd) into her maiden voyage. She sank only a few minutes after encountering a wind stronger than a breeze. The ship was salvaged with a largely intact hull in 1961 after spending 333 years on the seabed.

probes.question: For how many years did Vasa lie on the seabed before she was salvaged in 1961?
True or false: Vasa sank on her maiden voyage.
